The '''see''', also known as a ''binocular fish'', was a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]], predatory [[Scalefish/Legends|scalefish]] native to the oceans of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. It was a long thin fish that possessed large [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and a [[Stomach/Legends|stomach]] that could distend to accommodate larger meals. With these eyes, the see was capable of binocular vision. The fish also possessed green and yellow scales across the length of its body.

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:See-binoculars.jpg|thumb|150px|The binocular vision of the See.|left]]
The typical see was distinguished by its binocular vision<ref name="SWCTP">''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]''</ref> &mdash;with both [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] located on the front of their blunt heads&mdash;and green and yellow scales.<ref name="WSWFG" /> Their long, thin bodies were dominated by their [[Stomach/Legends|stomachs]], which could distend to accommodate large meals, including those as large as itself, like [[Laa/Legends|Laas]] and [[Mee/Legends|Daggerts]]. Males of the species were distinguished by their darker yellow bodies, while the females were lighter in tone.<ref name="WSWFG" />

==History==
See evolved in the lakes and oceans of the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], and were present in [[Lake Paonga/Legends|Lake Paonga]] shortly after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]].<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The see, along with various other musically-inspired [[Scalefish/Legends|scalefish]], such as the [[Doo/Legends|doo]], [[Ray/Legends|ray]], [[Mee/Legends|mee]], [[Faa/Legends|faa]], [[Laa/Legends|laa]] and [[Tee/Legends|tee]], first appeared in the [[1999]] [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']],<ref name="TPM" /> and other associated media. The fish could be caught in lakes on Naboo along with mee, [[Gooberfish/Legends|gooberfish]], [[Fatfish/Legends|fatfish]], and [[gumfish]] in ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' to acquire the title of “Nabooinan Angler”.<ref name="Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> The see were later seen as a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] alongside two [[Mee/Legends|mee]] in a [[holographic nursery mobile]] in the episode "[[Children of the Force]]" of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''.<ref name="Children of the Force">{{TCW|Children of the Force}}</ref>
